## ARTICLE 1: When the Census Becomes a Cyber-Battleground

| # | Claim | Assessment | Reasoning |
|---|-------|-----------|-----------|
| 1 | 2026 Census includes mandatory sexual identity/gender questions | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | No link to official ABS questionnaire design docs. ABS publishes draft topics months in advance — need confirmation these exact questions were approved and mandated. |
| 2 | 45,000+ scam reports within 24 hours | ❌ DISPUTED | ACCC Scamwatch aggregates reports weekly. Claim of 24-hour window with 340% increase from 2021 (which had ~8,600 reports) is mathematically inconsistent — 340% increase from 8,600 = ~28,640, not 45,000. |
| 3 | 12,000 scam reports within 6 hours | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Extremely specific timeframe. Scamwatch reports are aggregated; hourly breakdowns not publicly available. Need ACCC database query. |
| 4 | Russian-origin phishing infrastructure (Vladivostok server) | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Technical claim citing CyberCX report #CX-2026-AU-CENSUS. No URL or FOI reference provided. Server geolocation claims require network forensics evidence. |
| 5 | DigitalPersona Analytics Pty Ltd selling data for $2.50/record | ❌ DISPUTED | Extremely specific Australian company + pricing claim. No ASIC ABN lookup confirms this entity. ACCC investigation reference missing. |
| 6 | Digital Identity Protection Act passed Sept 2026 | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Future-looking claim. Would need confirmation via Federal Register of Legislation. Timing plausible but unverified. |
| 7 | 87 phishing domains taken down | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Specific number without source attribution beyond "internal documents." ASD/CERT Australia takedown reports would need citation. |
| 8 | Sarah Chen anecdote (abs-gov-au.com domain) | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Anecdotal example with specific timestamp. Domain `abs-gov-au.com` is a plausible typo-squat variant, but no Scamwatch report ID provided. |
| 9 | eSafety Commissioner quote about "sophisticated targeting" | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Quote format plausible but no citation to press conference transcript, media release, or social media post. |
| 10 | ABS CIO David Morrison email leak | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Specific internal quote + FOI claim. Need FOI request reference number to verify authenticity. |
| 11 | Dr. Fiona McLean, ANU Center for Social Policy Research | ❌ DISPUTED | No such center at ANU. ANU has Crawford School and College of Arts & Social Sciences. Verify person exists. |
| 12 | Dr. Andrew McCrea, ANU cybersecurity researcher | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Need ANU academic directory verification. |
| 13 | OECD Digital Security Observatory tracking census threats | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Verify OECD entity exists and monitors nation-state level data collection events. |
| 14 | $47M ABS infrastructure upgrade | ⚠️ UNCERTAIN | Claimed in Stage 1 sources but no budget allocation document link provided. Need Parliamentary Budget Office reference. |
